crosswalks.label: Software Developers
crosswalks.rationale: Software Developers ground runtime/service implementation while Model Serving Engineering narrows to model artifacts, routing and serving contracts.

crosswalks.label: Data Scientists
crosswalks.rationale: Data Scientists ground model/data context but do not own serving runtime, deployment reliability or artifact routing.

findings.summary: Model Serving Engineering must keep exact served artifact/runtime identity and service behavior separate from model quality/evaluation and broader operations authority.
findings.rationale: Research-first compilation makes the profession boundary explicit before use.

gaps_against_body.description: Make endpoint availability/performance, exact model identity, model-output equivalence and SRE/safety acceptance separate evidence surfaces.

nonclaims: No complete Model Serving Engineer reconstruction is claimed.
Occupational mappings are evidence, not profession identity.
No TEST/WORKING/CANON or adjacent authority is created.

high_stakes.authorization_nonclaim: No adjacent professional, user, legal, platform or institutional authority is created.
